applicabilityBasis.summary: Spark Blue Chip USDT Vault is an ERC-4626 USDT-denominated investment vault share. Interest, fees and realized investment losses alter the assets redeemable per share; the share carries no fixed monetary-value issuer redemption obligation.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07 as the exact Ethereum Spark Blue Chip USDT Vault holder receipt (0xb0c424116172b55cbb6dd3136f5989f7959e5b91), distinct from Spark Savings spUSDC and from direct parent USDT holdings. The native ERC-4626 share redeems at a variable asset exchange rate subject to strategy liquidity and investment results. GENIUS section 2(22) fixed monetary-value issuer obligation is not established for this yield receipt, so payment-stablecoin authorization, issuer pathway, foreign exception and DASP payment-stablecoin restriction are not applicable. No parent token authorization or issuerEntity is inherited. MiCA scope is independently assessed as outside this tracker EMT/ART model.
